raw:
```sql
SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) as avg_rating
FROM main."Player_Attributes" pa
WHERE pa.date = (
    SELECT MAX(pa2.date)
    FROM main."Player_Attributes" pa2
    WHERE pa2.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    AND pa2.date <= '2013-12-25'
);
```
